reviews.title: Great cooler
reviews.body: This is the best cooler I've ever owned. I camp a lot, so I needed a good cooler that stays cold for several days. This is it. But thats not even the best part. The best thing about this cooler is the refrigerator drawers. It keeps my lunch meat, cheese, etc cold just like a fridge , without it being submerged in ice. So instead of having meat and cheese that is soaked and slimy from being wet, its just like you took it straight from the fridge. 10 out of 10 recommend. Follow directions of how to prep the cooler and you will not be disappointed
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 20 July 2026

features: FROSTVAULT TECHNOLOGY: Cold transfers into FrostVault Dry Zone to keep food cool, dry and separate at food-safe temperatures (under 40° F) for days.
PREMIUM ICE RETENTION: Holds ice for days to keep up with any adventure.
HIGH CAPACITY: 30-quart capacity fits up to 48 cans (no ice) or 26 cans + ice.
SMARTER PACKING: Easily pack food without transferring to secondary watertight containers and keep drinks and food completely separate.
HEAVY DUTY: Highly durable construction with up to 3 inches of insulation.
EASIER ACCESS: Grab your favorite items without digging through ice or opening the lid.
HEAVY-DUTY HANDLES: Durable, integrated handles make the cooler easy to carry down to the beach, cookout or tailgate.
SECURE YOUR COOLER: Effortlessly secure your cooler with lockable lid and drawer latch. Bear-resistant when used with Ninja FrostVault Perfect-Fit Padlocks.
EASY LATCH: Premium latch allows you to easily open and close your cooler – even one-handed.
WHAT’S INCLUDED: Includes 30-quart cooler with FrostVault Dry Zone.
